description: Stereo gain stage that clips at ±5V, with a level control after the clipper

params.text: Sets the boost: with the range switch at 1x it runs from silence up to unity, and at 5x or 100x from unity up to that multiple
Picks the top of the gain knob's range, 1x, 5x or 100x
Scales the output after the clipper, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: Left audio in, and the signal sent to both outputs when the right jack is empty

outputs.text: The left channel boosted, clipped at ±5V and then scaled by the volume knob
The right channel boosted, clipped at ±5V and then scaled by the volume knob

notes: the lamp follows the right channel alone: red while that channel is being clipped and green while it is not, with the brightness following its level.
with the left jack empty and the right jack patched, the left output is held at 0V.

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
